issues: All 5 confirmed citations survive an independent fetch: Tibshirani full text Sec 2.2 eqs 8-9 and Sec 3.2; Hoff abstract; Dai NeurIPS page plus full PDF Table 1; Gunasekar abstract; Kolb arXiv abstract with its 'accepted at ICLR 2025' comment. Corrections: (1) The Hoff bibtex is an arXiv preprint entry, but the paper is published. Crossref for DOI 10.1016/j.csda.2017.06.007 gives Computational Statistics & Data Analysis 115:186-198 (2017), so use @article with that journal. (2) The recommended text says 'nonconvex l_q quasi-norm with q<1 ... here with q=b/nu'. But s=nu/b is in [1,nu/2], so q=b/nu is in [2/nu,1], and s=1 gives q=1 (convex l_1). Write q=b/nu<=1. (3) Every cited source states the b=2 case: a sum of squares on all parameters. The paper's per-neuron L_{2,b} cost gives nu^{b/2}A^{b/nu} by the same AM-GM step, so phrase it as a generalisation of the b=2 identity. (4) Dai et al. is stronger than the checker says: Table 1 states the exact depth-to-l_{2/d} rule, and gives l_{2/d,2} on the Fourier domain for conv nets. Put it first among the ML citations. Missed canonical prior art: Grandvalet 1998, 'Least Absolute Shrinkage is Equivalent to Quadratic Penalization', ICANN 98 (Crossref metadata fetched; body not read). Jacobs-Montufar 2605.19458 is correctly excluded here: it is about mirror-flow max-margin.
